notice.title: How we measure visits
notice.body: We measure visits anonymously with Umami, without cookies and without personal data. Your choice is saved in the browser.
notice.more: Read more in the privacy policy

consent.title: Your choice of cookies and external content
consent.body: We measure visits anonymously without cookies. The website also contains services from other companies that are loaded only once you accept them. You can change your choice at any time via “Cookie settings” at the bottom of the page.

necessary.label: Necessary
necessary.description: Required for the website to work, for example the contact form and remembering your choice here.

external.label: External content
external.description: Maps and other content fetched from other companies. They receive your IP address and may set cookies when the content is shown.

statistics.label: Statistics
statistics.description: Analytics tools from other companies that set cookies to track how the website is used.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.description: Advertising and marketing tools that set cookies to follow you between websites.

embed.info: {title} is fetched from {name}. When you show it, your IP address is sent there and cookies may be set.
